card.name: Linking words before drug interaction or infusion details
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or punctuation (the, is, by, a colon, include) just before a metabolism detail, a drug-level change, or a list of compatible infusion fluids in drug labels.

modes.label: Before infusion fluid lists
modes.description: A colon or 'include' right before a list of compatible intravenous solutions.
modes.example: Further dilution may be obtained with one of the following intravenous infusion solutions<<:>> Sodium Chloride Injection, USP,

modes.label: Metabolism and level wording
modes.description: A linking word in a sentence about enzymes, metabolism, or reduced plasma levels.
modes.example: The initial step in alprazolam metabolism<< is>> hydroxylation catalyzed by cy

modes.label: Partway through a word
modes.description: Inside a word being spelled out, before its main stem or ending.
modes.example: Drugs Affecting Urinary pH:<< Ex>>cretion increases with acidic urine; possible accumulation
